metadata.division: DIVISION 6-1-1. PURPOSE; PUBLIC INTERESTS; FINDINGS; AND RELATIONSHIP TO OTHER REGULATIONS

content.title: 6-1-1-1. Purpose of article.
content.summary: The purpose of this Article is to set out reasonable regulations for the design, location, installation, operation, repair, maintenance, and removal of signs in a manner that advances the City's legitimate, important, substantial, and compelling interests, while simultaneously safeguarding the const…

faqs.a: The purpose of this Article is to set out reasonable regulations for the design, location, installation, operation, repair, maintenance, and removal of signs in a manner that advances the City's legitimate, important, substantial, and compelling interests, while simultaneously safeguarding the constitutionally protected right of free speech.
